programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. programme.title: Dukun
programme.desc: Lawyer, Karim, is searching for his missing child, Nadia. His desperation leads him to be entangled with an alleged murderer, Diana Dahlan. In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: Pengasih
programme.desc: Love is often elusive and comes in all shapes and forms. In the case of newlyweds Anas and Bunga, love comes in a bottle - a love potion to be exact. When Bunga finds Anas's love potion on their wedding night, she finds it only fair if she has one herself to be used on Anas. A mutual agreement is made and what follows is their journey in search of love, literally.

He returned to seize family rights and fight for the mosque that has been donated for the benefit of the people. His uncle wants to sell the land and used an evil genie to destroy Farhan. Farhan is looking for clues to expel the jinn and is trying to awaken his uncle. Tragically, he is tortured with the supernatural powers. Will he escape the torturing?

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: Black Hand
programme.desc: Jung-woo is a highly successful neurosurgeon who works in a bioengineering research facility. He is married but is having a clandestine affair with one of the female doctors there named Yoo-gyeong. One day Yoo-gyeong has a muysterious accident and her hand is severed. But due to his quick action, Jung-woo is able to save her life and reattach her hand using a newly developed technology. The revolutionary surgery even improves Yoo-gyeong's health and she feels better than ever. But there are terrible side-effects as bizarre events begin to happen around her.

programme.title: Anguish
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Tess has suffered a pained past. She's been diagnosed with an assortment of mental ailments since her mother discovered her at a young age gruesomely banging her head against a wall. Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.
